title: Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 review: a record 8,535 runners in Kuching on 9 August, AIMS-certified 21K and 42K courses, and RM480,000 raised for charity.
dek: Kuching's August marathon grew by 45% in 2026, drawing a record field for its biggest edition since it began as the Isthmus Run in 2013. Here is what it was like, from the organiser's report.
verdict: The Sarawak Energy Marathon is the bigger, rebranded successor to the Sarawak Energy Isthmus Run, and 2026 was its largest edition yet: a record 8,535 registered runners in Kuching on Sunday 9 August, 45% more than in 2025 [1]. The 21 km and 42 km courses are AIMS-certified [1], total prize money was RM201,500 [1], and registrations raised RM480,000 for 16 Sarawak charities [1]. The 2027 race is set for 8 August [1]. If you want a certified marathon in Borneo in August, this is a strong choice. The account available is the organiser's own, so it covers scale and purpose, not how the race felt to run.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: More than 8,500 runners from Malaysia and 16 other countries gathered in Kuching on Sunday 9 August 2026, and the organiser counted a record 8,535 registrations across four categories: the full marathon, a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km competitive run and a 5 km fun run [1].
There were 83 international runners, with Brunei, Kenya, Singapore and Indonesia sending the largest groups [1]. Sarawak Energy's chief executive said participation was up 45% on 2025 [1].

sections.heading: Certified Courses and a Charity Purpose
paragraphs: The 21 km and 42 km courses were certified by AIMS, so times on them count on a recognised course [1]. Total cash prizes came to RM201,500 across all categories, with RM15,000 each for the open marathon winners [1].
RM480,000 raised through registrations went to 16 charities across Sarawak, RM30,000 each [1]. The race village had sponsor booths, food and drink, and family activities [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a marathon in East Malaysia with a certified course and a growing field, yes. The 2027 race is on Sunday 8 August, the second Sunday of the month as usual [1].

This is a corporate event run by Sarawak's electricity utility. What the available reporting does not tell you is how the course, water stations or timing held up on the day, so look for runners' accounts before you travel for it.
This review is compiled from the organiser's post-race release on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Sarawak Energy Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: A record 8,535 registered for the 9 August 2026 race in Kuching, across the full marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km. That was a 45% increase on 2025, and it included 83 international runners from 16 countries.

faqs.question: Is the Sarawak Energy Marathon course certified?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 21 km and 42 km courses were certified by AIMS (the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races), so times run on them are recorded on an internationally recognised course.

faqs.question: When is the Sarawak Energy Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 8 August 2027. The race is held each year on the second Sunday of August in Kuching. It began in 2013 as the Sarawak Energy Isthmus Run before becoming the Sarawak Energy Marathon.
